entities.summary: The Mariupol Regional Intensive Care Hospital, formerly known as Mariupol City Hospital No. 2 is the largest hospital in Mariupol and in the Donetsk region (Ukraine), designed to provide inpatient and outpatient tertiary level care to residents of the region and secondary to the population of the Central region of Mariupol.
